title: Shell Bar
description: Fiori application header with branding, content, collapsible search, notifications, custom items, overflow, profile and product switch (ui5-shellbar).

usage.summary: Provide a consistent product header with branding and global entry points.
useWhen: Let users recognize the product and reach global search, notifications, profile and other products from every screen.
Keep global functions available while the page content or navigation target changes.
Provide search through ShellBarSearch and use profile, notification and product-switch callbacks to open the appropriate surfaces.

avoidWhen.when: Group actions that apply to page content or selected table items.
Arrange a local page or dialog header/footer in start, center and end areas without global product functions.
